data.headline: Thirty-year Treasury yield drops six basis points to 5.24%
data.summary: Long-maturity Treasury yields moved lower on November 25. The thirty-year yield fell from 5.30% to 5.24%, and the ten-year fell from 4.91% to 4.85%.

bull.text: Lower yields increase the price of an otherwise unchanged fixed-rate bond. Both benchmark yields fell by the same amount.

bear.text: Asset managers reduced their net long in Treasury bond futures from 394,990 to 371,794 contracts in the week to November 17. Those positions predate the November 25 yield move.

watch.text: The thirty-year yield remained 39 basis points above the ten-year. The next Treasury reading will show whether the spread moves as yields change.

limitations: Treasury benchmark yields and futures positions measure separate exposures. TLT’s session return requires independently verified ETF prices.
